items.name: Glasgow Favourites Evening III 2025

venue.name: Learning and Teaching Building, Strathclyde University

items.information: ## Please read the [Favourites Competition Format tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GlasgowFavEveningIII2025#54472-favourites-competition-format) before registering. You are only able to register for a few of the events available at this competition. ##### Please be aware that this is an evening competition and does not begin until 5:30pm ### This competition will run in 2 groups. You will compete in one group and run, judge, or scramble for the other group. You MUST be present for the entirety of both groups (i.e. 5:40pm - 8:50pm) otherwise you will not be allowed to compete. Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above. [![Imgur](https://i.imgur.com/OXOffhf.png)](https://www.ukca.org/)

items.name: Stockholmsligan Nne - Kifaru 2025

venue.name: Arena Satelliten
venue.details: Klubben. Entrance through "Entré A", in front of the bus stops. The front door might be locked, but we will open it at regular intervals - contact the organizers if you are stuck outside.

items.information: Varmt välkomna till den fjärde deltävlingen i vårsäsongen av Stockholmsligan 2025! Alla är varmt välkomna att delta, oavsett om du löser kuben på 5 sekunder eller 5 minuter samt oavsett tidigare tävlingserfarenhet (eller tidigare deltagande i serien). Läs gärna igenom alla flikar på denna sida så du inte missar någon viktig information. -- A warm welcome to the fourth competition in the spring season of Stockholmsligan 2025! Everyone is welcome to participate, regardless of whether you solve the cube in 5 seconds or 5 minutes and regardless of prior competition experience (or participation earlier in the league). Please read through all the tabs on this page so you don't miss any important information. [![](https://cuboss.se/wp-content/uploads/2024/01/cuboss-svekub-loggor.png)](https://svekub.se/om_oss/svekub-cuboss/)
